summary: Quartzsea Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K announcing the postponement of its Extraordinary General Meeting from June 18 to June 23, 2026, to seek shareholder approval for an extension of its initial business combination deadline from June 19, 2026 to October 19, 2026 via up to four monthly extensions. In connection, the redemption right deadline is extended to June 23. The monthly contribution to the trust account will be the lesser of $0.033 per public share or $175,000. This is a routine SPAC extension filing typical of blank-check companies nearing their liquidation deadline. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and potential redemptions, which could affect trust size and deal feasibility.
